summary: Correct, minimal fix that replaces the `in` membership test (which triggers `__eq__` and the numpy array truth-ambiguity ValueError) with identity checks against each sentinel. Sentinels (mock.DEFAULT) are singletons, so `is` comparison is semantically correct and resolves the bug generally.

issues.description: Multi-line list-comprehension reformatting is a slight style choice; a single inline `any(...)` generator would keep the diff tighter, but this is cosmetic and does not affect correctness.
